name: Planar Channeling
body:
You can invoke the power of your deity’s realm when channeling energy.

Prerequisite(s): Channel energy or invoke realm class feature, must worship and receive spells from a deity.

Benefit(s): You gain the invoke realm ability of an idealist cleric and can use it whenever you channel energy, in place of the usual effects. If you already possess the invoke realm ability, this feat instead allows you to channel energy as a standard cleric.
